result.title: SplatTok: Data-Driven Compression of 3D Gaussian Splats with Scene-Level Tokens
result.summary: 3D Gaussian splats enable real-time rendering but require substantial storage. Existing compression methods either encode the primitives of a given splat or optimize a compact representation independently for each scene. Yet a Gaussian splat is only one realization of a scene: different arrangements of primitives can produce nearly identical rendered views. We exploit this freedom on the decoding side with SplatTok, a learned scene-resynthesis codec. Trained across thousands of real-world scenes, a transformer encodes an existing splat into compact, spatially anchored latent tokens, and a shared decoder synthesizes a new set of standard Gaussian primitives without preserving correspondence to the input. The representation is learned through rendering supervision rather than primitive reconstruction. At compression time, a quantization-aware latent search refines only the scene code, keeping the networks frozen, and closes most of the encoder's remaining error. On standard benchmarks, using only renders of the input splat for the latent search, without the original training images, SplatTok matches the PSNR of the feed-forward codec FCGS with 4 to 6.5 times smaller files, compressing input splats about 75 to 110 times. With the training images, it exceeds the PSNR of the per-scene method HAC++ with 13 to 41% smaller files. A single model trained on DL3DV generalizes to unseen scenes with millions of Gaussians and supports multiple target rates without retraining.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SplatTok，一个学习式场景重合成编解码器：用 transformer 把 3D Gaussian splat 编码为空间锚定的紧凑 latent token，共享解码器直接合成新原语，并以渲染而非原语重建作为监督；压缩时冻结网络，仅用量化感知的 latent 搜索细化场景码。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「冻结解码器、只搜索 latent，且仅以渲染结果监督」的设定，可能为 LVR 中推理期 latent 状态如何细化、以及输出监督能否真正塑造内部视觉表示提供可核查的方法线索，但论文本身不涉及多模态推理。
